profile.headline: Engineering cloud environments
profile.summary: As an infrastructure and software engineer, I specialize in building modern products and platforms that leverage Kubernetes, containers, tooling, and applications to enable developers to utilize cloud-native computing. My passion lies in automating infrastructure, extending cloud environments, and implementing software engineering principles to manage infrastructure at scale.

positions.title: Vice President - Global Technology - Infrastructure Developer
Vice President - Global Technology - Engineer Lead
Senior UC Consultant
positions.description:
Technical leader providing UC/HCS design and implementation services including Call Control, Session Management, Unified Messaging, various endpoints, and other collaboration solutions.
• ​Leading Large Scale Voice Rollouts:​ Designed and led NYC’s Government IT agency hosted voice deployments to ~50k end-users across all agencies.
• ​Developed standards & best practices:​ created implementation and operational standards for engineering and support clients.
• ​Trained and Mentored engineers:​ Collaborated with engineering peers and clients to deliver hours of training on Cisco voice products and coaching junior engineers​.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Provided solution testing services related to voice and video for the Cisco Hosted Collaboration Solution. Specialized in Unified Domain Manager, SIP Session Management, Unified Communications Manager, Unity Connection, and IP phones.
• ​Integrating and Testing Voice Systems:​ Led systems testing by building large scale testing environments. Created test plans and scenarios for engineers to expose software bugs.
• ​Technical Leader:​ team lead for HCS test cycles acting as a mentor, team builder, decision maker, and individual contributor​. Eg. contributed to Cisco’s first UC hosted service, which rolled out to various global Service Providers like Verizon, Telstra, Sprint, and NTT.
• ​Cisco Conference Speaker:​ presenter at Cisco Live 2012 & 2013 US, London and Australia sessions, trained over 300 students in 8-hour Collaboration Solution Labs and also participated in Meet The Engineer one-on-ones​.

positions.title: UC Network Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered global enterprise Cisco Collaboration architectures and services incorporating VoIP products from the Cisco collaboration portfolio.
• ​Primary Trusted Advisor​: established trusting relationships directly with customers and communicated with those representing various levels of technological expertise.
• ​Designing and Implementing Voice Systems:​ lead large-scaled design and migration services for fortune 500 companies with successful deployments of Cisco Call Manager, Voicemail, Messaging, and (SIP) Gateways systems.
• ​Voice Architecture Validation:​ gathering customer business and technical requirements to create high and low-level design documentation of voice solutions.

positions.title: Network Field Engineer
positions.description:
Provided technical solutions and supported organizations with diverse environments including help desk and managed IT services for small to medium size businesses. 

•	Maintained knowledge and competency in all desktop related technologies. 
•	Developed excellent analytical and problem-solving techniques by troubleshooting software and hardware issues.
•	Maintained technical documentation for internal and external publication.

projects.title: Cisco Live 2013 - Orlando: Cisco Hosted Collaboration Solution Lab
projects.description: Developed and presented an 8hr HCS instructor-led lab for customers to use the centralized management system that provides fulfillment and service assurance to HCS Service Providers/Partners.  The lab provided hands-on and theoretical knowledge for deploying HCS. It exposed customers to an SP HCS deployment by providing hands-on experience provisioning HCS customers with end-to-end cloud-based voice, video, voicemail, presence, and IM services.

projects.title: Cisco Live 2013 - Australia: Cisco Hosted Collaboration Solution Lab
projects.description: Developed and enhanced HCS Self Paced Walk-In labs presented to 100's of customers at the World of Solutions during Cisco Live in Australia. Demonstrated the power and capabilities of the HCS solution focusing on the fulfillment of UC services and service assurance.
